model_annotation: The image displays three donut charts comparing the number of enterprises, number of persons employed, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021, based on absolute values from NACE Rev. 2. The first chart, "NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES," shows four sectors: Industry (61%, 19.0 million), Construction (12%, 3.7 million), Trade (19%, 5.9 million), and Other Services (8%, 2.4 million). The second chart, "NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED," presents the following distribution: Industry (51%, 80.2 million), Construction (9%, 13.4 million), Trade (19%, 29.5 million), and Other Services (21%, 33.0 million). The third chart, "TURNOVER," indicates: Industry (31%, 9.8 trillion), Construction (6%, 1.9 trillion), Trade (31%, 9.9 trillion), and Other Services (33%, 10.6 trillion). Each chart includes a legend at the bottom that matches the color of each sector to its label: Industry (yellow), Construction (blue), Trade (red), and Other Services (dark blue). The percentages and absolute values are displayed within or adjacent to each segment of the donut charts. The sectors in each chart are arranged in a clockwise order, generally in descending order of their percentage share.
